- key_parameters: rnaseqResult=A data frame of RNA-Seq results (e.g., from DESeq2 results()) ;; filterInput=Logical indicating whether to filter input genes based on standard thresholds (default: adjusted p-value < 0.05, absolute fold change > 1.5) ;; order=Type of PPI network to build (e.g., "zero", "minimum", "first") ;; analysis=Enrichment method to use ("sigora", "reactome", "hallmark", "kegg") ;; gpsRepo=Gene Pair Signature Repository for sigora (default is "default" which uses human Reactome reaH, or "kegH" for KEGG) ;; split=Logical indicating whether to split genes into up- and down-regulated before enrichment ;; columns=Number of columns to split the pathway plot into (up to 3) ;; maxDistance=Maximum distance threshold for pathway similarity in pathnetFoundation()
- alternatives: analysis="sigora" (default) uses gene-pair signatures to reduce false positives from promiscuous genes, whereas analysis="reactome" (ReactomePA) or analysis="hallmark" (MSigDb) use traditional over-representation analysis (ORA). KEGG is also supported via analysis="kegg" or analysis="sigora" with gpsRepo="kegH".
- when_to_use: When analyzing RNA-Seq differential expression results across one or multiple comparisons to identify biological significance via pathway enrichment, PPI networks, and visualizations.
- pitfalls: Traditional ORA assumes all genes in a pathway have equal value, which can lead to false positives due to overlapping/promiscuous genes (e.g., kinases). Use sigora to mitigate this. Different p-value cut-offs and adjustment methods are used: sigora uses Bonferroni adjustment with a strict threshold (adjusted p-value < 0.001) because the gene-pair universe is much larger, whereas ReactomePA/Hallmark use Benjamini-Hochberg with adjusted p-value < 0.05. Ensure gene IDs are compatible (e.g., Ensembl IDs or Entrez IDs depending on the database/method used).

workflows.name: rna_seq_downstream_analysis
workflows.intent: Visualize differentially expressed genes and perform pathway enrichment analysis on RNA-Seq results.
input: rnaseq_results.rds (A list of data frames containing DESeq2 results with columns like log2FoldChange, padj, etc.)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate a volcano plot using eruption() ;; 2. Plot fold changes across comparisons using plotFoldChange() ;; 3. Perform pathway enrichment using pathwayEnrichment() ;; 4. Plot pathway enrichment results using pathwayPlots()
workflows.code:
eruption(
    rnaseqResult=exampleDESeqResults[[1]],
    title=names(exampleDESeqResults[1])
)

plotFoldChange(
    inputList=exampleDESeqResults,
    pathName="Interferon alpha/beta signaling"
)

enrichedResultsSigora <- pathwayEnrichment(
    inputList=exampleDESeqResults,
    analysis="sigora",
    filterInput=TRUE,
    gpsRepo="default"
)

enrichedResultsHm <- pathwayEnrichment(
    inputList=exampleDESeqResults,
    analysis="hallmark",
    filterInput=TRUE,
    split=TRUE
)

pathwayPlots(
    pathwayEnrichmentResults=enrichedResultsSigora,
    columns=2
)

workflows.name: ppi_network_analysis
workflows.intent: Build, visualize, enrich, and extract subnetworks from Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) networks using DEG results.
input: rnaseq_results.rds (A list of data frames containing DESeq2 results)
workflows.stages: 1. Build a PPI network using ppiBuildNetwork() ;; 2. Plot the PPI network using ppiPlotNetwork() ;; 3. Enrich the network nodes for pathways using ppiEnrichNetwork() ;; 4. Extract a subnetwork based on an enriched pathway using ppiExtractSubnetwork() ;; 5. Plot the extracted subnetwork using ppiPlotNetwork()
workflows.code:
exNetwork <- ppiBuildNetwork(
    rnaseqResult=exampleDESeqResults[[1]],
    filterInput=TRUE,
    order="zero"
)

ppiPlotNetwork(
    network=exNetwork,
    title=names(exampleDESeqResults)[1],
    fillColumn=LogFoldChange,
    fillType="foldChange",
    label=TRUE,
    labelColumn=hgncSymbol,
    legend=TRUE
)

exNetworkPathways <- ppiEnrichNetwork(
    network=exNetwork,
    analysis="hallmark",
    filterResults="default",
    geneUniverse = rownames(exampleDESeqResults[[1]])
)

exSubnetwork <- ppiExtractSubnetwork(
    network=exNetwork,
    pathwayEnrichmentResult=exNetworkPathways,
    pathwayToExtract="INTERFERON GAMMA RESPONSE"
)

ppiPlotNetwork(
    network=exSubnetwork,
    fillType="oneSided",
    fillColumn=degree,
    label=TRUE,
    labelColumn=hgncSymbol,
    legendTitle="Degree"
)

workflows.name: pathway_similarity_network
workflows.intent: Construct and visualize pathway-to-pathway similarity networks from enriched pathway results.
workflows.stages: 1. Load the Sigora database and calculate pathway distances using getPathwayDistances() ;; 2. Create a foundation network of pathways using pathnetFoundation() ;; 3. Filter enriched pathways for a specific comparison ;; 4. Create the pathway network using pathnetCreate() ;; 5. Visualize the pathway network using pathnetGGraph()
workflows.code:
data("sigoraDatabase")

pathwayDistancesJaccard <- getPathwayDistances(pathwayData = sigoraDatabase)

startingPathways <- pathnetFoundation(
    mat=pathwayDistancesJaccard,
    maxDistance=0.8
)

exPathwayNetworkInput <- enrichedResultsSigora %>%
    filter(comparison == "COVID Pos Over Time")

myPathwayNetwork <- pathnetCreate(
    pathwayEnrichmentResult=exPathwayNetworkInput,
    foundation=startingPathways
)

pathnetGGraph(
    myPathwayNetwork,
    labelProp=0.1,
    nodeLabelSize=3,
    nodeLabelOverlaps=8,
    segColour="red",
    themeBaseSize = 12
)
